title: Implement bounded facet availability, filtered fallback roundtrips and readable labels
objective: Keep the frozen discovery result contract while making canonical facets honest and usable across live and accepted fixture paths, including unresolved values, narrowed/empty responses and captured labels absent from the current page.
outcome: UI-only availability/reasons and count-free include-unknown controls are derived from current result scope; fixture filtering roundtrips locally; retrieval-core changes only existing facet label strings; frozen contracts and both reference engines remain byte-preserved.

commits.subject: Preserve isolated catalog record accounting
commits.instructions: Reconcile the accepted 3434 corpus denominator, 3430 searchable rows and exact four CDC records with typed partial results without changing source bytes or schema pins.
commits.verification: The isolation regression reports the exact baseline counts, IDs, hashes and partial response.

commits.subject: Bound facet availability to current results
commits.instructions: Project the five canonical dimensions into shared UI facets, preserve selected/removable controls through narrowed and empty responses, expose scoped availability reasons and apply canonical filters in the fixture provider without changing the frozen response schema.
commits.verification: Focused web tests cover unknown-only/uniform states, no-count absent controls, selected removal, same-dimension OR, cross-dimension AND and fixture filtering.

commits.subject: Add facet labels and fixture roundtrip evidence
commits.instructions: Resolve existing live facet option label strings from complete matching records, isolate intentional label differences in both reference comparisons and record the complete producer handoff.
commits.verification: Retrieval parity and isolation tests pass; C0063 proves page-absent captured labels and unchanged non-label response fields; full web and retrieval suites pass.
